== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|Nelula Seiren is the Planetary Governor{{!}}Planetary Governor of Visiria and a member of the [[Visiri]] species. She possesses pink skin, an elaborate hairstyle, and various gold and [[ruby]] adornments on her neck, wrists, ears, and hair. A notable physical feature is her glowing red third eye, which is considered a symbol of good fortune. In public and private interactions, she often adopts a gentle, grandmotherly persona, appearing both tender and beloved by her people. Politically, she represents [[Visiria]] as a significant part of the [[Karoshan Alliance]]. During confrontations, such as when being challenged by the [[Captain of The Last Horizon]], she has demonstrated a resolute and unflinching demeanor.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|This elderly woman possesses pale pink skin and hair arranged in an intricate nest style. Her neck, wrists, ears, and hair are adorned with the shine of rubies and gold, and she features a glowing red third eye.}}

== The Knight ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|Nelula Seiren serves as the Planetary Governor{{!}}Planetary Governor of Visiria. As an [[old woman]], she possesses pale pink skin and wears her hair in an elaborate nest style. Her appearance is further distinguished by a glowing red third eye and adornments of gold and rubies upon her hair, ears, neck, and wrists.}}
